answer: Anchor each identity to a licensed amateur-radio callsign. Every epoch the holder must whisper a fresh callsign-and-nonce phrase in WSPR mode, on a band assigned that round; listening posts triangulate the signal and check it against the registered antenna orchard and the shale ground of the claimed site. One callsign, one identity; a licence takes an exam, a fee, and a public record. A farm wanting a hundred votes needs a hundred licensed operators, radios, and antennas: clones from one orchard collapse to one vote, and a forged callsign burns the bond. An honest holder whispers once.
